nodes.summary: The decision problem CLOSEST STRING accepts a bitstring $x$ exactly when $x$ decodes, under the canonical bitstring encoding of closest-string instances, to an instance that is well formed and feasible. Bitstrings that do not decode to a closest-string instance are rejected.
nodes.title: The CLOSEST STRING decision problem

nodes.summary: Write $\ell(x)$ for the length of a bitstring $x$. A closest-string instance $(S, d)$ is feasible when there is a bitstring $c$ with $\ell(c) = \ell(s_1)$, where $s_1$ is the first bitstring of $S$ (and $\ell(c) = 0$ if $S$ is empty), such that for every $s$ in $S$ the number of positions $j < \min(\ell(c), \ell(s))$ at which $c$ and $s$ differ is at most $d$.
nodes.title: Feasible closest-string instances

nodes.summary: A closest-string instance is a pair $(S, d)$ of a finite list $S$ of bitstrings (finite lists of booleans) and a natural number $d$, the distance bound.
nodes.title: Closest-string instances

nodes.summary: The CLOSEST STRING decision problem belongs to NP, and every decision problem in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to it.
nodes.title: CLOSEST STRING is NP-complete

nodes.summary: A closest-string instance $(S, d)$ is well formed when all bitstrings in the list $S$ have the same length.
nodes.title: Well-formed closest-string instances

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
